The '''main base''' of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]] after the Rebels left [[Chrellis Base]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' begins after the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'' establishes that the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] occurs at the end of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]{{'s}} second tour of duty. Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Events in ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'' before the end of the second tour of duty therefore take place in 1 BBY.</ref> the Rebels were already planning to relocate again when they learned that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] planned to [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] the base as the first stage of an offensive code named [[Operation Strike Fear]]. The Alliance quickly evacuated the Brigia base<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> and relocated to [[Orion IV]].<ref name="CSWE" />
